source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Λεωνίδης και οι Αγίες Χάρισσα, Νίκη, Γαλήνη, Καλλίδα, Νουνεχία, Βασίλισσα και Θεοδώρα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Eight names in one line, so eight folders; she shares a couplet with Theodora, «Eις την Bασίλισσαν και Θεοδώραν», and the two are told apart by the line's own naming of them. The page gives no year: it sets them only «στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Δεκίου (249 - 251 μ.Χ.)», a reign and not a date, so there is no `dates` object. The corpus holds four others of this name — Basilissa of Rome, whom saint.gr keeps on 15 April, Basilissa of Nicomedia, Basilissa of Sirmium and the wife of Julian of Antinoopolis — and none of them is drowned off the Peloponnese under Decius. The page prints no hymn in full.
